rules: Every issue of the repository. worker "bot": assigned (now or before) to cm-ai-ops-bot, or a linked pull request by cm-ai-ops-bot, factory-worker-author, cursor, Copilot or another bot account, or a factory label or factory-state comment (the record on the issue). worker "team": everyone else. agent is that identity.
Kept: every open item, and closed items closed, merged or deployed in the last 56 days.
Linked pull request: closing reference; "Closes/Fixes/Resolves/Refs #N"; a title ending "(#N)"; branch factory-worker/<N>-* or issue-<N>-*; the pull request named in a factory-state comment.

column: the item's Status on project 679 (node PVT_kwDOD_ESUc4BliGL) when readable, else cm-ai-ops-bot's journal lines only (A → B). A factory-state comment is not a column. Derived advances: PR opened → Review; merged → Merged (docs-only → Done); tdd/uat/prod deploy → TDD/UAT/Done. A closed issue that never reached Merged is Done when closed.
releaseCandidate: the first release (GitHub deployment 'release', version of its master Build run) whose commit contains the merge commit of the item's last merged pull request.
environments.<env>: the first non-reverted pin of ui in that environment whose release contains the merge commit (version, pin time), while the commit running there (delivery.json) still contains it.
ftFailures: the most of the demotion count, "Review: FAIL" verdicts and moves from Review back to an earlier column; reverts: merged pull requests of the item reverted on the default branch.
